name: [Forge] Seamless Loading Screen  2.0.3+1.20.1
changelog:
Seamless Loading Screen 2.0.3 minor fixes for some issues involving screenshots and config loading.

## Fixes:
- Fix targeting issues involved with no Screenshots taken when leaving a world. 
- Fix YACL deserialization issues with malformed config data
- Add backward compatibility with older config for color

name: [Forge] Seamless Loading Screen  2.0.2+1.20.1
changelog:
Seamless Loading Screen 2.0.2 implements various fixes for more mod compatibility

## Features:
- Added Global Server blacklist within config

## Fixes:
- Add more failsafe to prevent the Mouse from being blocked forever
- Prevent FadeScreen replacement when not fading
- Fix Debug Screen crash when closing the world
- Fix issue involved with Tint Value not saving within the config

name: [Forge] Seamless Loading Screen  2.0.1+1.20.1
changelog:
Seamless Loading Screen 2.0.1 fixes minor bugs involved with mod compatibility

## Fixes:
- Fix compatiblity issues with Fastload, Fastquit and kennytvs-epic-force-close
- Add fallback for mods who do various screen stuff during loading

### Fabric
- Fix to high of loader version leading to issues on quilt

### Forge
- Attempt fix Rubidum (Forge version of Sodium) causing crashes

name: [Forge] Seamless Loading Screen  2.0.0+1.20.1
changelog:
Seamless Loading Screen 2.0.0 is finally out with new various new features and fixes combined with native forge and fabric versions for the latest Minecraft.

## Features:
- New Effects like blur and tint
- Ability to play sound effect after loading

## Fixes:
- Fix fade being completely broken
- Fix mod incompatibles like Bedrockify
- Fix crashing with IPv6 address used within the screenshot file name
